caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock with a dark reddish-brown color and wood grain texture. The clock features two vertical columns on either side, and a wide, layered top molding. In the upper portion, there is a square clock face with a cream background, black Roman numerals, and two black hands showing the time as approximately 2:39. The area surrounding the clock face is bordered by darker wood frames. Below the clock face, there is a small rectangular glass panel framed with a pattern of green and gold trim. Behind the glass, a gold circular pendulum hangs in front of a painted scenic landscape, which includes two trees in the foreground, a patch of green grass, blue water, and a row of light-colored buildings with red roofs in the background. The clock is centered on a plain, off-white background, and a small handwritten inscription appears in the lower right corner.
title: Mantel Clock
